statement.zh: **协议**：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换（SPAKE2+, an Augmented Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) Protocol）。RFC 9383 摘要给出机制定义：「This document describes SPAKE2+, a Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol run between two parties for deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password.」并说明它是增强型：「SPAKE2+ is an augmented PAKE protocol, as only one party has knowledge of the password.」。
statement.en: **Protocol**: SPAKE2+, an Augmented Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) Protocol (SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换).The abstract defines the mechanism: "This document describes SPAKE2+, a Password-Authenticated Key Exchange (PAKE) protocol run between two parties for deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password." and states the variant: "SPAKE2+ is an augmented PAKE protocol, as only one party has knowledge of the password."。.

statement.zh: 动机是口令不能裸奔于交换过程：摘要把目标写成「deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password」，并把工程卖点列在一起——「This method is simple to implement, compatible with any prime-order group, and computationally efficient.」。
statement.en: The motivation is that a password must not be exposed by the exchange: the abstract states the goal as "deriving a strong shared key with no risk of disclosing the password" and bundles the engineering claims with it — "This method is simple to implement, compatible with any prime-order group, and computationally efficient."。.

statement.zh: 使用位置写在 §1：增补性质在执行受限、攻击者无法提前查询口令散列盐值的场景特别有价值，文件举出两类约束——「a constraint may be when physical proximity through a local network is required or when a first authentication factor is required for initiation of the protocol.」摘要给出通用形态：只有一侧持有口令，仍完成认证并得到会话密钥。
statement.en: The placement is in §1: the augmented property is valuable where execution is constrained and the adversary cannot query the salt of the password-hashing function ahead of the attack, and the document names two constraints — "a constraint may be when physical proximity through a local network is required or when a first authentication factor is required for initiation of the protocol." The abstract gives the general shape: only one party holds the password, yet authentication and a session key result.A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records.

statement.zh: 限度一是身份模型：「SPAKE2+ is the asymmetric or augmented version of SPAKE2, wherein only one party has knowledge of the password.」服务器侧仍需保存盐值/记录。限度二是标准地位：文件自陈「Neither SPAKE2 nor SPAKE2+ was selected as the result of the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) PAKE selection competition.」，页眉 Category 为 Informational，不是 Standards Track。
statement.en: The first limit is the identity model: "SPAKE2+ is the asymmetric or augmented version of SPAKE2, wherein only one party has knowledge of the password." — the other side still stores the salt or record.The second is standing: the document states "Neither SPAKE2 nor SPAKE2+ was selected as the result of the Crypto Forum Research Group (CFRG) PAKE selection competition." and its masthead Category is Informational, not Standards Track.

statement.zh:
版本信息在页眉：流别为 Independent Submission，Category 标注 Informational，日期 September 2023，作者 T.Taubert（Apple Inc.）与 C.A.Wood。§1 交代血缘：本文内容从「[RFC9382], which specifies SPAKE2」拆出，因对称与增补 PAKE 的用例不同而分别规范。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\Pi}_A(\lambda)\le n\cdot\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{prf}}_F(\lambda)+\varepsilon_{\mathrm{aead}}(\lambda)\)。输入：输入：SPAKE2+ 口令认证密钥交换的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：Π 协议，A 敌手，n 会话数，PRF/AEAD 为底层原语。
statement.en: The masthead gives the history: the Independent Submission stream with Category: Informational, dated September 2023 and authored by T.Taubert (Apple Inc.) and C.
